features.mega_menu: portable definitions, menu-item binding, rich panel editor and accessible responsive renderer implemented

notes: WooCommerce version ranges remain unset until the Phase 0 environment audit and compatibility matrix are completed.
The module extends public Theme hooks and does not patch Theme source at runtime.
Rich mega-menu content is stored in the versioned customer profile under the Layouts module configuration and contains no executable PHP or JavaScript.
Browser-based responsive/RTL/accessibility regression testing and full Shop/Product/Cart/Checkout visual template editing remain Phase 2 follow-up work.
